dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast light perimeters with irregular, serrated edges transitioning into darker focal centers. The most distinct annuli are concentrated on the mid-to-posterior dorsal-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters is present, primarily distributed across the lower-lateral region and near the anterior flipper junction, lacking internal intensity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four primary dorsal-lateral annuli form an irregular quadrilateral, while secondary relationships establish a series of acute triangles across the posterior flank.
